title: The State of the Blockchain Industry — and Where Polkadot Fits
description:
The blockchain industry is no longer in its experimental phase... but it isn’t settled either. In this episode, I step back from price charts and narratives to look at the actual state of the industry today: what has succeeded, what is stagnating, and where structural tension is quietly building across major networks.

Rather than asking which chain is winning, this video asks a more useful question: which problems remain unsolved and what crisis is each network facing? From Bitcoin's maturity to Ethereum’s fragmentation, scaling trade-offs, and developer reality, we explore where blockchain stands as an industry, not as a marketing battleground.

From there, I explain where Kaspa fits into that landscape: not as a competitor chasing hype, but as a network exploring a different set of design assumptions.This is not an endorsement video, nor a maximalist argument.
It’s a systems-level overview meant for builders, thinkers, and anyone trying to understand where blockchain is actually headed.

Email: [EMAIL]

Article: https://medium.com/@james_allan/c75371725255
Instagram: JamesAllan0
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/cityxcape

The blockchain industry is no longer in its experimental phase... but it isn’t settled either. annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it discusses blockchain networks, including their engineering, governance, scaling, reliability, and architectural challenges, without making a concrete investment solicitation. References to consulting, Patreon, likes, and channel support are separate audience or service-related requests rather than conditions for purchasing cryptocurrency or obtaining a promised return. A sampled Coinbase staking interface with an APY figure does not establish that the creator promotes a deceptive offer or that a transaction or return occurred.
